rule: Every role gets one visible route, one proof reason, one money rule, and one next screen.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment collection and no rental commission. Buyers pay suppliers directly while Heavyster earns listing SaaS revenue.
design_intent: Keep Heavyster calm and global-ready by showing the safest route before deeper workflows.

routes.promise: Search, compare proof, and send one direct enquiry.
List one machine, verify proof, refresh availability, and activate paid SaaS.
Choose the next market wedge by demand, supply, trust, and listing ARR.

acceptance: Build Phase shows v144 Serene Route Planner.
The route planner appears directly under the Calm Action Bar.
Buyer, supplier, and founder states each show start, proof, money, and next screen.
Copy route explains one visible route and the 0% rental take guardrail.
The route planner remains compact on desktop and mobile.
